markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier 4 case with single-class set, high reliability, and model agreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, InSitu 2%, Normal 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong Benign, minimal Invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (10% alpha, 90% coverage) | Single class at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliable, 64th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input, no flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | true (same top class) | Independent models agree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal (60%) [F5] | Five non-malignant neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (-1.12) [F2], 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.28) slightly raises risk [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.26) favors benign [F4] · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 1, 9, 10) · context · 25 neoplastic nuclei; morphometry unavailable · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful deletion test (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020); all 12 region risks are 0.
- **Concepts**: Unverified deletion test (95% CI -0.009 to +0.006); top driver normal_lobules is unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is Normal, matching 2/5 neighbors (BACH_0071 at 90%, BACH_0076 at 88% similarity).
- Focal InSitu (2%) or invasion (regions 8, 11) is masked by unreliable normal_lobules scores.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Verify benign lobules directly (unreliable concept) and region 11 (invasion score 1.0).
2. **Region 8**: Inspect ducts for atypia or pleomorphism (+0.28 duct_confined contribution).
3. **Regions 1, 5**: Confirm benign tubules and region 1 fibrous stroma or fat.
